_comment: The street rods' four diners in the player's words (diners/diners.json): diner.name.<id> its name, diner.about.<id>
a line about the place on the map's card, diner.region.<id> the part of town it is in. diner.title, the diner's name
where none is given, in place of the core's ("replace").

lines.diner.about.mainstreet: Where everybody starts out: sixes, small V8s and small bets on Main Street.
lines.diner.about.hiway: A truck stop grill out by the yards. The regulars have some iron under the hood and race for a bit more.
lines.diner.about.surfside: The coffee shop on the strip by the beach, where the fast cars park out front and the bets get serious.
lines.diner.about.starlite: The Googie palace up on the boulevard. The big names, the big engines and the big money. The King eats here.
